# Output format of `ioreg -d2 -c IOPlatformExpertDevice`.
# Serial values are fictional; the surrounding structure - in particular the
# properties that sit next to the serial - is what the parser has to handle.

        "manufacturer" = <"VMware, Inc.">
      }
